items.Korean: 이봐, 항복. 항복이야. 원하는 게 뭐야? 뭘 말하면 돼?
items.English: Hey, surrender. Surrender, I said. What do you want? What do I need to say?

items.Korean: 그거? 그래. 그렇지. 있지. 그거 때문에 이 난리를 피워? 그냥 얌전히 물어봤으면 되잖아, 이 새끼야!
items.English: That? Yeah. Right. I do. Is that why you're making all this fuss? You could've just asked nicely, you bastard!

items.Korean: CP에서 샀어. 생체 칩 파는 곳은 거기뿐이라고. 난 그냥 떼다 파는거야. 뭣도 아닌 소상공인이라고.
items.English: Bought it from CP. They're the only ones selling biochips. I'm just reselling them. Just a small-time dealer, nothing special.

items.Korean: …보안 확실하다더니. 약쟁이 새끼 말을 들은 내가 병신이지.
items.English: ...Said the security was solid. I'm an idiot for listening to that junkie bastard.
Who can I get it from?

items.Korean: J 클린에서 팔아. 조씨한테 샀어. 내가 잘 연결해줄게. 그 눈빛 좀 어떻게 하라고.
items.English: J Clean sells them. I bought mine from Mr. Jo. I'll hook you up. And do something about that look in your eyes.

items.Korean: 아니, 다 알려줬는데 이럴 필요가 없잖아.
items.English: No, I told you everything. There's no need for this.
Open the backdoor. Don't regret it.
